purpose: ETC (Electronic Throttle Control) compliance evaluation: BYD 472QC requirements against Vitesco ETC12 product specification.

documents.relative_path: PDF/ETC general product specification-ETC12 - 副本.pdf

cases.query: The ETC actuator shall operate in the temperature range of -40°C to +140°C.
The ETC actuator shall meet IP6K9K protection class per DIN 40050-9.
cases.decision_rationale: Both specify IP6K9K, VT additionally references DIN 40050-9 standard.

cases.source_locator: OEM Comparison / Position sensor / Supply voltage
cases.query: The position sensor supply voltage shall be 5V ±0.5V.

cases.source_locator: OEM Comparison / Position sensor / Current consumption
cases.query: The position sensor current consumption at 5V (2 channels) shall not exceed the specified value.
cases.decision_rationale: BYD requires 12mA which is LOWER than VT's 21mA. VT spec is less strict, so VT product may not meet BYD's tighter limit.

cases.source_locator: OEM Comparison / Position sensor / Linearity (LMS to LHP)
cases.query: The dependent linearity (new part, LMS to LHP) shall be within ±1%.
cases.decision_rationale: VT ±1% is TIGHTER than BYD ±1.5%, so VT product exceeds BYD requirement.

cases.source_locator: OEM Comparison / Position sensor / Response time
cases.query: The position sensor response time (10% to 90%) shall be less than 1ms.
cases.decision_rationale: VT typical 1.8ms is significantly SLOWER than BYD's <1ms requirement.

cases.query: The position sensor hysteresis shall be less than 0.1°.
cases.decision_rationale: VT <0.2° is WIDER than BYD <0.1°. VT product may not meet BYD's tighter hysteresis limit.

cases.source_locator: OEM Comparison / DC Motor / Nominal voltage
cases.query: The DC motor nominal supply voltage shall be 12V.

cases.source_locator: OEM Comparison / DC Motor / Continuous current
cases.query: The DC motor continuous current (arithmetic average at 120°C) shall not exceed 1.7A.
cases.decision_rationale: VT max 1.5A is LOWER than BYD max 1.7A, so VT product meets the requirement with margin.

cases.source_locator: OEM Comparison / DC Motor / Control frequency
cases.query: The DC motor control frequency shall support 360 to 2000 Hz.
cases.decision_rationale: VT range (360-10000Hz) fully covers BYD range (360-2000Hz).

cases.source_locator: OEM Comparison / Air mass flow / TP diameter
cases.query: The throttle plate diameter shall be 50mm.
cases.decision_rationale: VT uses 52mm diameter vs BYD 50mm. Different physical sizes may require manifold adaptation.

cases.source_locator: OEM Comparison / Air mass flow / Air leakage
cases.query: Air leakage at LMS (1013hPa, R.T.) shall not exceed 2.5 kg/h.
cases.decision_rationale: VT ≤3.0 kg/h exceeds BYD ≤2.5 kg/h limit. However note different DK sizes (52mm vs 50mm).

cases.source_locator: OEM Comparison / Response time / R.T. idle to WOT
cases.query: Response time at room temperature (idle to WOT, T90) shall be less than 100ms.
The DC motor inductivity at 1kHz shall be approximately 1.6mH.
cases.decision_rationale: VT 1.2mH±20% (range 0.96-1.44mH) does not cover BYD 1.6mH. Significant difference requires engineering review.

cases.source_locator: OEM Comparison / Position sensor / Nominal slope
cases.query: The nominal slope of the position sensor shall be 0.952% Us/°.
